My  mother died 52 years ago, and my father 33 years ago, and I can share that my heart still has the a deep empty space of longing to spend more time...to ask more questions,  to hold and hug them more, to tell them how much I love them.  I am thankful of all the beautiful memories, all the little sayings, all the traditions that I have asked God to fill my heart with that they so proudly passed along.  I think about the wonderful advice,  that back then seemed a bother, but has proven to be invaluable and cherised beyond words.  I guess, I never realized how much they loved me and sacrified for me, and my sibblings.  One of the most profound memories that I have is that, I never heard them complain about anything.  They accepted whatever came their way, and dealt with it with grace.  Each night before I go to sleep, I thank God, for all that I have, all that I've had, and for all that I may have one day.  Most often, my tears have become my prayers and I know that God knows what they're about.....I whisper to my beautiful mother and father, "I'm sorry, for not loving you more deeply, holding you tighter, asking you more questions about you, and your concerns....I was too busy and immature thinking about me...  The best part is I know that my parents would forgive me, they were very forgiving and understanding.  I am so thankful for their beautiful, most precious and loving hearts,  and one day we will have a huge family reunion in our Heavenly home...Oh, what a great time that will be.  So, until then, we use every moment that comes along, that brings us calm and peace...and yes, reflection to feed our soul.This is good, and I know it would bring huge smiles to their faces.   My hope is that my most precious son, whom I love with every ounce of my being and beyond, will feel the depth and scope of my forever love when he remembers me...he is indeed my greatest blessing.... text: My father never let me sit on his lap or be his little girl like in the movies but he did talk to me. We played by making faces at each other but my mother said that was disrespectful and would not allow it, even though that was his way of playing with me since he was not good with words. 現在の科学的理解では、

「2030年に氷河期が来る」という説は主流ではありません。

太陽フレア、地震、火山噴火は地球環境へ影響しますが、それだけで急速な全球氷河期になる証拠はありません。

太陽フレア（X級）について

X級太陽フレアは非常に強い爆発ですが、主な影響は：

通信障害

GPS障害

オーロラ増加

衛星への影響


などです。

太陽フレアそのものが「地球を冷やす」わけではありません。
むしろ太陽活動が長期的に弱まる場合（黒点減少など）が気候変化と関係すると考えられています。

たとえば17世紀の「マウンダー極小期」では、太陽活動低下と寒冷化（小氷期）が重なりました。

火山噴火の影響

理由は：

火山灰

硫黄エアロゾル


が成層圏に広がり、太陽光を反射するからです。

1991年のピナツボ火山では、世界平均気温が一時的に約0.5℃低下しました。

もし超巨大噴火が複数起これば、

数年規模の寒冷化

農業被害


は起こり得ます。

ただし、それでも「数万年続く本格氷河期」とは別です。

地震との関係

海底火山活動

プレート変動

津波による海流変化

「氷河期が早まる」可能性は？

現在の主流研究では：

地球軌道だけを見ると、将来また氷期サイクルは来る

しかし人為的CO₂増加がそれをかなり遅らせている可能性が高い


とされています。

「2030年に急激な氷河期へ突入する」

という科学的コンセンサスはありません。

太陽活動低下

大規模火山噴火連鎖

海流変化（AMOC弱化など）
